title: Clara was a wonderful...
text: Clara was a wonderful guide and it was a great way to be exposed to Barcelona during a short visit. The fresh air TuTu was refreshing.
author: MaryEllen_F

title: Beautiful way to see Barcelona
text: Great way to see Barcelona. My 2 hour tour covered the city and the parks. The driver lives in the city and shared many local stories about each area plus the history of the people.
author: Cindy_C

title: Our TUK TUK Experience
text:
Our tour today was @ 1.00pm and met all our expectations .Our driver Harvi was outstanding , very knowledgeable about the landmarks and surroundings, he’s also a good photographer too.
The traffic this day was bad ,very heavy and he was safe driver .
It was a very enjoyable tour .
We did a Tuk Tuk tour in Paris and it is the best way to see the layout of the city in a short amount of time  and I would highly recommend it when in Barcelona .5+⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
author: SUSAN_V

title: Barcelona!!!!
text: This tour is fun, educational and informative! Our tour guide Leo is very knowledgeable of the architecture and history of Barcelona. I highly recommend this tour to those wanting  to learn more about the art city!
author: Jonathan_T

title: Happy days
text: Very educational Connie was superb throughout.,had a really good 2 hour experience. Would recommend the tour.
author: Lee_C

title: 2hour trip
text: I did the 2 hour tour and we enjoy the trip, the guide was very informative and also reccomend us what to do in the city and where to eat. BEST 2 hour spent in the city
author: michaelrC2268KD

title: Order now! Informational and fun.
text: Great experience.  Learned a lot. Had fun. Driver was amazing and very knowledgeable.  He knew the streets of Barcelona and how to get around them. The 2 hours flew by.
author: francesca_h

title: We enjoyed the 2 hour...
text: We enjoyed the 2 hour tour.  Very safe driver who gave us a lot of information.  They did block a small amount of time for us to walk areas that we weren't really interested in doing, so he had to pivot and take us to other places to fill the time.  We had a good time.
author: Jeff_S

title: Must do!
text: This was honestly the best money I spent in Barcelona I had a really small amount of time there and I wanted to see as much as I could, but since this was not the only part of my European travels, my feet were killing me, and I just could not do one more walking tour experience. So I’m really glad that I did it. My only critique is that I paid for two hours and I didn’t quite get the full two hours and I do wish that I would’ve gotten to see inside one of the parks.
